LESSON: SIGN READING 6.2.1 VISUAL DISCRIMINATION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Sign reading 6.2.1 Visual discrimination
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign reading 6.2.1 Visual discrimination, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How is the weather today? 2. Which clothes do we wear on a hot day?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign reading 6.2.1 Visual discrimination together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: making observation skills as learner matches and pairs pictures of weather symbols and

activities happening.

● Self-efficacy as learner discusses about pictures observed on weather conditions to others in class.

Values:
● Integrity: as learner works with others with honesty and discipline as they view weather pictures and talk about

them.

● Social justice as learner with others share learning resources such as picture flash cards equitably.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Preventive health awareness as learner learns that we should dress warmly during cold weather conditions to avoid

illnesses related to coldness.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Environmental activities where the learner draws pictures on symbols of weather.

Suggested Learning Resources: Adapted course books, signed audio visual clips, books, Flash cards, charts, pictures,

digital devices, online resources
